svg.title: Pakistan, 2025: advertising cost per qualified respondent in four places in Sindh
svg.desc: Radius areas in four places in Sindh, August to September 2025, with advertising cost per qualified respondent: Hyderabad, 33 radius areas, $0.80; Karachi, 181 radius areas, $1.19; Around Sukkur, 15 radius areas, $2.21; Around Larkana, 36 radius areas, $3.14.
svg.text: SINDH, PAKISTAN, 2025 · 265 RADIUS AREAS IN FOUR PLACES
1 km radius areas in the city; 4 km on its edges
radius area (a pin with a 1, 4 or 5 km radius)
AD COST PER QUALIFIED RESPONDENT, MEN AND WOMEN POOLED
28 Aug – 13 Sep 2025. Together the radius areas cover 2.9% of Sindh. Cost is recorded per group of radius areas, not per area.
